title: Coherent cone-square transposition through derived pullback
statement: Assume derived categories on schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix g:S-prime to S, complexes A,B on S and A-prime,B-prime on S-prime, with arrows t:A to B and t-prime:A-prime to B-prime. Let G be underived direct image, F its complex functor, eta its localization comparison [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], and adj the pinned Lg-star/Rg-star adjunction [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. For any alpha:A to F(A-prime), beta:B to F(B-prime) and specified homotopy H:t beta homotopic to alpha F(t-prime), there are complexes C,D on S-prime, s:C to D, a:C to A-prime, b:D to B-prime and H-prime:s b homotopic to a t-prime. Isomorphisms d1,d2,d3 identify Q(C),Q(D),Q(Cone(s)) with Lg-star Q(A),Lg-star Q(B),Lg-star Q(Cone(t)) [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then Q(a),Q(b),Q(Cone.mapOfHomotopy(H-prime)) are d1,d2,d3 followed by the adjoint transposes of Q(alpha) eta, Q(beta) eta, and Q(Cone.mapOfHomotopy(H) followed by the inverse additive cone/G comparison) eta. There is no cover, base-change square or coefficient object in this statement.

source.document: Stacks Project, Cohomology of Sheaves and Derived Categories

proof.text: Use the existing functorial flat resolution and its K-flat resolution functor on t:A to B. Naturality gives a strict square p y=x t with K-flat P,Q and quasi-isomorphisms x,y. Precompose the specified homotopy H with x and the strict square. Expanding its cone components proves that its cone map equals Cone.map(p,t,x,y) followed by the original specified cone map.

Transpose this replacement square using the additive adjunction cone compatibility lemma. The cone comparison c becomes invertible after localization because the other two components of its cone-triangle morphism are invertible. The replacement cone is K-flat.

Use the K-flat pinned adjunction comparison on P, Q and Cone(p). Compose its three isomorphisms with Lg-star of Q(x), Q(y), Q(c), and on the cone also the inverse additive pullback cone comparison. Naturality of the inverse homEquiv under precomposition gives exactly the three displayed equations.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedPullback_cone_square_transposition
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {S S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (A B : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (A' B' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B') :
    let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F := G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let η := schemeMVDirectImageLocalization g
    let adj := relativeMVAdj g
    ∀ (α : A ⟶ F.obj A') (β : B ⟶ F.obj B')
      (H : Homotopy (t ≫ β) (α ≫ F.map t')),
    ∃ (C D : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (s : C ⟶ D) (a : C ⟶ A') (b : D ⟶ B')
      (H' : Homotopy (s ≫ b) (a ≫ t'))
      (d₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj A))
      (d₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D ≅ (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj B))
      (d₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone s) ≅
        (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t))),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map a =
        d₁.hom ≫ (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ η.app A') ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map b =
        d₂.hom ≫ (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ η.app B') ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H') =
        d₃.hom ≫ (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso t' G).inv) ≫
              η.app (CochainComplex.mappingCone t'))
